description: The Contractor shall provide equipment, tools, materials, parts, vehicles, other items and services necessary to perform remedial maintenance, preventative maintenance (PM), Service Reports and Repair Emergency Repairs, for 10 3-ton Bards and 6 4-ton Bards at Building 1503/1508 and Bi-annual preventive maintenance for one Mitsubishi City-Multi ACCU at the Joint Multinational Simulation Center, Bldg 1503 & 1508, Schofield Barracks, Hawaii.
